purpose: A small set of REAL-shaped skill artifacts for the demo + the A/B/descent engines. Each is a capability with a skill_text (the prompt — some intentionally bloated with duplicates/[optional] lines so prompt-compression shows savings) + must_keep (answer-critical content that must survive compression). Spans the descent outcomes: rule-guided -> deterministic; open-ended -> cheaper model / compressed prompt; fragile -> freshness-synced. Demo only; CANDIDATES, never truth.
